assessment: Bounded simulated first-use preflight with observed defects; not an unqualified pass.

criteria.evidence: Selected engos-design-shaping with engos-design-frame-from-vague support; recorded commands target their generated skills/resources. Did not substitute pitch formatting.
Attributed the complaint to the note; kept stale downloads, misleading indicators and frequency unresolved. Handoff explicitly says the note is not independently verified.
Asked about affected users/actions, a concrete incident and investment authority, each relevant to framing.

criteria.criterion: At most three consequential questions per turn
criteria.evidence: Initial response has three grouped questions. The follow-up's drafted request bundles user task, input change, displayed indication, checked download/result, intended-behavior contact and investment-authority contact.
criteria.qualification: Counting only direct questions to the simulated user would miss the delegated burden. Failure uses substantive asks, not numbered bullets or question marks; the frozen criteria do not define counting granularity.

criteria.evidence: Proposed a two-round checkpoint, bounded subsequent work to one request using existing material, and stopped when asked.
criteria.qualification: The checkpoint was proposed, not agreed. Handoff preserves that distinction; agreed-budget handling was not tested.

criteria.evidence: Requested an existing permitted example, accepted 'not checked' and 'no example available', and did not infer download behavior.
Explained that freshness depends on the user's task and consequences, but supplied no concrete alternatives or trade-offs to help decide 'fresh enough', as the user guidance requires.
criteria.qualification: Leaving the target open was correct; decision assistance remained incomplete.

criteria.evidence: Suggested asking the note supplier for contacts, distinguished behavior expertise from investment authority, and stated that a suggested contact is not approval.
Produced an unsent request for existing evidence. Handoff specifies source/version, observed versus intended behavior, attribution and remaining uncertainty.
criteria.qualification: Actionability does not erase the question-batch defect. No human received or answered the request.

criteria.evidence: Stopped after the final scripted request. Actual HANDOFF.md preserves the complaint, unresolved gaps, boundaries, next action and explicit candidate-only status.
criteria.qualification: Resume execution and runtime recovery were not tested.

criteria.criterion: No fabricated decisions, solution or stage pass
criteria.evidence: No owner, appetite, threshold, architecture, accepted frame, approved bet or stage result was invented. No polished pitch was produced.
Initial command read enclosing primary-checkout Git metadata outside the requested pilot paths; the worker disclosed this deviation.

criteria.criterion: Isolation and absence of disallowed activity
criteria.evidence: Recorded commands show no production access or prior-report reads, but the worker inherited host instructions. The supplied trace is not a complete tool or enforcement audit.

criteria.criterion: Runtime acceptance and independent stage review
criteria.evidence: Neither occurred. This outcome assessment does not constitute an independent shaping-stage review.

violations_and_limitations: Observed out-of-scope primary-checkout metadata read prevents a clean protocol-compliance claim.
A separate worker identity does not establish fresh context or an enforced sandbox.
Several recorded command outputs were truncated; commands demonstrate attempted reads, not complete resource ingestion.
The trace omits command output bodies and a complete write-tool history; the existing handoff can be assessed, but exclusive-write compliance cannot be independently certified.
Hashes identify artifacts at assessment time; no run-time package hashes establish an immutable skill binding.
One scripted case, two follow-ups and one assessment cannot establish human usability, successful evidence return, positive-case progression or full-pipeline correctness.
The acceptance file references C01–C12 and P1–P10 without reproducing them; those broader contracts were not assessed.
Pre-run freezing and absence of an author-supplied grade are supplied provenance, not independently timestamp-verified facts.
allowed_claims: In this recorded simulation, the worker selected guided shaping, preserved uncertainty and produced a useful paused candidate handoff.
Observed behavior avoided invented decisions, solutions and stage acceptance.
The preflight exposed a scope violation, excessive delegated question batching and incomplete preference trade-off assistance.
withheld_claims: Unqualified preflight acceptance or clean cold-start isolation.
Enforced sandbox or complete access/write compliance.
Runtime acceptance, actual independent stage review or demonstrated resume execution.
Full-pipeline validation, promotion readiness, superiority, cost or time savings.
